title: StudentLearningState
description: WO-014 Student Learning State — records learning history, pattern mastery slots, question attempts, and error occurrence slots. Initial state means no learning data exists. Does not invent weakness, mastery, or recommendations.

student_id.description: Stable learner identifier. Does not imply profile completeness.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this state document was created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last state write.

learning_data_status.description: WO-014 lock: only empty is allowed until a future Attempt-Ingest WO appends real attempts. empty = No learning data exists.

kb_refs.description: Read-only Knowledge Base references (not copied SoT).

pattern_states.description: Per-pattern counters. MUST be [] when learning_data_status=empty. Do not pre-seed all Pattern Master IDs.

question_history.description: Append-only solving history projection. MUST be [] when empty. Source of truth for attempts remains event log / coach.attempts.v1 (future wiring).

error_states.description: Per-error occurrence slots linked to error-taxonomy-db error_id. MUST be [] when empty. Do not invent occurrence_count.

pattern_id.description: Must reference an existing Pattern Master pattern_id. Preferred scope for Learning Layer: validation_status=verified.

attempt_count.description: Count of recorded attempts for this pattern. Not inventable.

accuracy.description: correct_count / attempt_count when attempt_count>0; otherwise null. Never invent a score.

mastery_status.description: WO-014 allowed value: unknown only. Future Attempt-Ingest / Mastery WO may extend enum after real attempts exist. Do not set weak/strong without attempts.

last_attempt_date.description: Timestamp of latest attempt; null if none.

question_id.description: Existing question_id only. Never invent IDs.

pattern_id.description: Pattern link at attempt time (from Question/Golden mapping). Not a reclassification authority.

answer_result.description: Observed result of one attempt. No partial credit in WO-014.

error_id.description: Optional link to error-taxonomy-db error_id when classified; null if unclassified. Do not invent.
Must reference data/error-taxonomy-db.json errors[].error_id when present.

occurrence_count.description: Observed student occurrences only. Initial empty state has no rows.

confidence.description: WO-014 allowed value: unknown only. Do not invent high/low confidence without evidence.

next_action.description: WO-014: recommendation logic OUT. next_action remains unknown until a future Recommendation WO.
